findings.drift_origin: systematic +Y accumulation from alternating swing-leg lateral impulses (left-stance pushes CoM right, right-stance pushes left, but not symmetric due to initial phase asymmetry)
findings.abd_control_limitation: hip abd torques create body tilt moment but negligible net lateral GRF when both feet near vertical -- lateral CoM force requires foot displacement, not joint torque
findings.best_result: 7 alternations / 2.97s with corrected hip_y sign -- insufficient for 12s/10-alt target
findings.critical_finding: lateral drift rate ~0.05-0.10 m/step, abd torque creates at most ~0.01m/step lateral correction -- 5-10x insufficient

recommendation: V20 step-width control required: place swing foot LATERALLY to shift support polygon under CoM each step
